text:
maria_csm: Hi team — quick week1 enablement/status update for EmberWave private deploy. Short summary and asks: networking peering mostly done, KMS key created but policy + rotation evidence pending, IAM role mapping needs one doc tweak, audit log sink exists but retention shorter than customer requirement. Raising potential renewal risk if KMS evidence isn't delivered within a week. @devon_net can you confirm NAT IPs and whether route propagation finished? :eyes:

devon_net: NAT IPs assigned: 34.90.12.8/32 and 34.90.12.9/32. VPC peering routes appear, but route-propagation still shows one missing AZ route. I can run BGP/route validation next Tue and share results.

arik_security: I created the KMS key in us-west-2. Need to add the service principal policy so Redwood can perform envelope encryption operations. Draft policy below — please validate: 

arik_security: ```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey*", "kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01"
}
```

arik_security: Rotation is enabled (annual), HSM-backed key material confirmed — customer keystore is AWS CloudHSM-backed CMKs. I'll attach exportable audit map.

zoe_se: Did a runbook walkthrough with Julia yesterday. She asked for a 45-min enablement replay with the runbook annotated and screenshots for the Console KMS policy page. Proposed time: Fri 10am PT. Also asked about cost visibility for private model calls per-route — can we show token-level breakdown in Console? :money_with_wings:

customer_contact_julia: Thanks — priority is SOC2 evidence for KMS and rotation. Also noticed some egress flows missing from logs (specifically 10.3.5.0/24). Need clarity on where those packets are captured.

maria_csm: Action items captured: (1) @devon_net schedule BGP/route validation and confirm egress flow capture (2) @arik_security finalize KMS policy JSON, rotation cadence, HSM confirmation and export audit map (3) @zoe_se run enablement replay Fri 10am PT and attach runbook with screenshots (4) I'll open follow-up support ticket and short feedback survey for EmberWave to capture runbook clarity + enablement usefulness (5) @oliver_pm flag renewal-risk if KMS evidence not delivered within 7 days.

oliver_pm: Acknowledged. If we don't receive final KMS audit evidence by 1950612345 I'll mark renewal-watch and escalate to AE for timeline commitments.

maria_csm: Quick feedback ask for Julia: can you fill a 3-question runbook clarity survey? https://forms.redwood/privnet-feedback (should take ~1 min) :pray:

customer_contact_julia: Done — left feedback asking for console screenshots and a clearer note about log retention policy mapping to their SIEM.

maria_csm: Thanks — I'll add a screenshot step and update the runbook. Pinging again once KMS policy + audit map land. :white_check_mark:
